jennifer: Hey team — suddenly seeing 401 invalid_api_key in production after a scheduled key rotation. Only affects our web clients, server-to-server calls are fine. Started ~10:40am UTC.

maria.s: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact curl or request header you're using from the web client?

jennifer: Repro from affected user session: `fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer abcDEF12345' } })` -> 401. When I copy that same header into curl it works.

sam.k: Odd. If curl with same header works, maybe the client is modifying the header before send. Any proxy/cdn in front of the site?

jennifer: We do have FastEdge CDN and an auth edge worker that injects headers for analytics. Rolling back the worker temporarily removes the 401s (verified).

maria.s: Can you capture the exact header value that reaches our API? If you can share the request as seen by our logs that helps.

ops-bot: Received request-id=rg-84ab12cd for 1778501234, client_ip=34.82.10.5, auth_header_received="bearer abcdef12345"

sam.k: Aha — logs show the Authorization header lowercased to `bearer abcdef12345` (value also lowercased). Our keys are case-sensitive. I suspect the edge worker normalizes tokens to lowercase when copying headers into the analytics header.

jennifer: That makes sense. The edge worker has a helper `normalizeHeader(value)` that was meant to trim whitespace but a later change did `value.toLowerCase()` for storage. We missed that it would affect Authorization.

maria.s: Ok quick mitigation: change the worker to avoid lowercasing `Authorization` values and redeploy. In the meantime, you can rotate the key and provision a new key that the worker will not mangle (but better to fix worker).

sam.k: Proposed fix snippet: ```js
// bad: analyticsStore.save('auth', authHeader.toLowerCase())
// good:
analyticsStore.save('auth', authHeader.trim())
```

jennifer: Will patch and deploy now. Thanks — can you keep an eye on error rate post-deploy?

maria.s: Yep — I'll watch the 5xx/401 dashboard and confirm when the rate returns to baseline. :eyes:

ops-bot: Deploy registered: edge-worker/analytics-fix @deploy-39124 by jennifer — status: rolling
